faq: 01How do I get started with Success Path Mentors?Contact us through WhatsApp and share the student's grade, subject, curriculum, preferred teaching language, current learning challenges, and available times. Our team will review the information and help arrange the appropriate next step.

02Is the trial lesson free?A free trial lesson may be arranged for eligible new students before beginning a regular package. The purpose is to understand the student's needs, introduce the tutoring experience, and help determine an appropriate tutor and starting point.

03How is the tutor selected?Tutor selection considers the subject, grade level, curriculum, preferred teaching language, student availability, and individual learning needs. The goal is to provide a suitable match rather than assigning the same tutor profile to every student.

04How long is each lesson?Lesson duration can vary according to the student's age, subject, program, and selected arrangement. The exact lesson duration is confirmed with the family before regular lessons or package payment begins.

05Are lesson times flexible?Yes. Lessons are arranged online according to tutor availability, student availability, school commitments, and time-zone differences. Regular attendance is encouraged to support consistent progress.

06Which subjects and curricula are available?Success Path Mentors supports a range of subjects including Mathematics, English, Science, Physics, Chemistry, French, Arabic, and other available programs. Support may include Canadian, American, Quebec, and other curricula depending on the grade, subject, and available tutor.

07Can we request a different tutor?Families may contact the support team when the current match does not meet the student's academic or communication needs. The situation will be reviewed and an alternative tutor may be considered based on availability.

08How is the student's progress followed?Progress may be followed through lesson feedback, completed work, priority skills, homework follow-up when applicable, and communication with the family. The level of reporting depends on the student's program and tutoring arrangement.

09What happens if a lesson needs to be rescheduled or cancelled?Families should contact the team as early as possible when a lesson cannot be attended. Rescheduling, cancellation, late-notice, and missed-lesson conditions are confirmed before payment and are handled according to the applicable policy.

10How are package payments handled?Package prices are shown in Canadian dollars. Before payment, the family should confirm the number and duration of lessons, payment method, applicable taxes, renewal arrangements, and the relevant cancellation or refund conditions.

11Do you provide online tutoring for students in Milton?Yes. Success Path Mentors offers one-to-one online tutoring for elementary, middle, and high school students in Milton. Lessons follow the Ontario curriculum and are conducted through interactive online sessions scheduled flexibly around family routines.

12Can students in Toronto book one-to-one online tutoring?Yes. We serve students across Toronto and the GTA with personalized online tutoring in Mathematics, English, Sciences, and school exam preparation, connecting learners remotely with qualified mentors.

13Do you support the Ontario curriculum?Yes. Our tutoring is directly aligned with Ontario Ministry of Education curriculum guidelines, supporting elementary foundational strands through secondary course codes including Grade 9 Math (MTH1W), Grade 10 Math (MPM2D), Grade 11 Functions (MCR3U), Grade 12 Advanced Functions (MHF4U), Data Management (MDM4U), Chemistry (SCH3U/SCH4U), and Physics (SPH3U/SPH4U).

14Which grades and subjects do you support in Ontario?We provide one-to-one online tutoring for students in Grades 1 through 12 across Ontario in Mathematics, English, General Science, Chemistry, Physics, and targeted school exam preparation.
